verdict.rationale: Brex offers a broad developer API (accounting, budgets, team, webhooks) plus an llms.txt and an official MCP server, showing genuine API-first investment, but no OpenAPI spec is discoverable and there's no evidence of full UI/API parity — many UI features (e.g., AI-powered automation, GL coding automation) are not confirmed to be API-accessible, and community feedback questions Brex's AI/engineering execution.
